description: WSO2 SAP S/4HANA Reservation Document provides a way to interact with the [Reservation Document API](https://api.sap.com/api/API_RESERVATION_DOCUMENT_SRV/overview). The service allows to retrieve, create and delete reservation documents.
key-features: Create reservation documents to set aside material for later use
Read and delete reservation document headers and items
Query reservations by material, plant and requirement date
